contexts.text: Nothing heavenly is seated in their minds, but only what is earthy, which they call dross.
Like gold which has dross within.
They differ like... dross and gold.

The house of Israel is to Me become dross... they are even the dross of silver (). By these words are described the false doctrinal things which the Jews and Israelites had framed from the sense of the letter of the Word, and which they had applied solely to themselves and their own loves; which are called the dross of silver, because silver = the truth of the Word; and dross, nothing of truth, or that which is abstracted from truth, which is rejected.
When the essential things are rejected, all the rest are dross...
